title: The Battle Hymn of the Republic
commons_title: File:The Battle Hymn of the Republic (1995) - Singing Sergeants - United States Air Force Band.mp3
composition: music by William Steffe, words by Julia Ward Howe (1861); both public domain
performer: Singing Sergeants, United States Air Force Band
credit: Arrangement and performance by the United States Air Force Band (a work of the US Government, public domain).
lyrics: Mine eyes have seen the glory of the coming of the Lord
He is trampling out the vintage where the grapes of wrath are stored
He hath loosed the fateful lightning of His terrible swift sword
I have seen Him in the watch fires of a hundred circling camps
They have builded Him an altar in the evening dews and damps
I can read His righteous sentence by the dim and flaring lamps
